data.summary:
When one of your **AELDARI** units arrives from **Strategic Reserves**, it may be set up anywhere wholly within 6" of the Webway Gate. If it is:

- it may be set up closer than 9" to enemy models, including within **Engagement Range** of them
- if it is placed within Engagement Range of an enemy model, then this turn it is **eligible to fight** and counts as having completed a **Charge move**
